attributes.action: Make pre-stunning of sheep mandatory before Halal slaughter
attributes.additional_details: The Government keep rejecting pettitions to end Halal slaughter. Why cant they introduce a human British pre-stunning if they wont ban Halal meat. This is the UK we dont want our animals to suffer and now they are demanding us to belly and neck clip our sheep , by doing this we are accepting that this is fine to kill sheep this way
attributes.background: Make pre- stunning a requirement before sheep are slaughtered for halal meet. We as farmers have a care of duty of the sheep we sell and we do not want them to be killed by a blade to the throat and let them suffer! Also scrap belly clipping which causes Unnecessary stress to the sheep.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

End the religious slaughter exemption and require irreversible stunning
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/783423
